title: Excise deprecated feature gateway and normalize route versioning
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Remove an aging feature gateway and legacy routing/versioning paths introduced during early rollout experiments. The feature-gateway service and flag-dispatcher dual-write shim are sources of increased complexity, inconsistent rollout behavior, and production incidents tied to mismatched version fingerprints. This ticket standardizes route versioning, migrates persisted rollout metadata to the canonical fingerprint v2 format, and removes runtime handling for legacy queryparam and header-based versioning. The goal is to reduce operational cognitive load, eliminate edge-case fallback code, and simplify future rollout automation.
background: Historically we supported multiple rollout/versioning signals (X-Rollout-Hint header, ?version=0 query param, plus a feature-gateway proxy that rewrote routes). Those compatibility layers accumulated special-cases. In the last 12 months we've observed two incidents where mismatched rollout fingerprints caused canary traffic to be misrouted and a spike in 500s during synchronized releases. Platform teams agreed to converge on a single canonical fingerprinting scheme and excise the deprecated gateway. This is a service-level tech debt reduction that benefits Dedicated and Private customers by making route manifests deterministic.
scope: Remove the feature-gateway microservice and its runtime router middleware
Deprecate and remove queryparam-based version resolution (eg. ?v=0) across public routers
Migrate stored rollout fingerprints from 'fingerprint-v1' to 'fingerprint-v2' with a reversible migration script
Remove dual-write shim between flagstore-v1 and flagstore-v2 and verify no callers remain
Update SDKs and API surface to reject legacy versioning signals and return 400 with guidance
Add observability: dashboards for rollout mismatch rates, 5xx trends, and migration progress
acceptance_criteria: All production clusters no longer run feature-gateway and no traffic is routed through it
Migration script completes in staging and production; rollout fingerprint column updated for >=99% of manifests
Public routers return a deprecation error for legacy ?v queryparam when the header is missing
Automated tests cover canonicalization logic and reject legacy signals
No increase in 5xx rate or median p95 latency post-cutover (verified by canary metrics)
Security review completed and audit logs show no unintended permission escalations
tasks: Spike: inventory all code paths that parse X-Rollout-Hint and ?v queryparam (ENG-132457-spike)
Write reversible migration for rollout fingerprints (migration-2380) and test on snapshot data
Remove feature-gateway deployment manifests and update infra IaC (k8s + helm)
Deprecation response: SDK and API changes to return 400 + migration guidance
QA: create staging canary with 10% traffic for 48h and run synthetic traffic suites
Add dashboard panels: rollout-mismatch-rate, migration-progress, gateway-traffic-0
End-to-end test: simulate simultaneous canary and full rollout and assert deterministic routing
Backout plan and rollback automation to re-enable compatibility layer (feature toggle controlled)
